system.description: A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.
system.notes:
Normal | Minion

A decaying corpse ambling toward their prey.
Motives & Tactics: Eat flesh, hunger, maul, surround

Difficulty: 8 | Thresholds: None | HP: 1 | Stress: 1

ATK: -3 | Bite & Claw: Melee | 2 physical

Experience: None

Features

Minion (2) - Passive: The Zombie is defeated by any damage. For every 2 damage a PC deals to a Zombie, defeat one additional Minion within any range the same attack would have hit.

Group Attack - Action: Spend 1 Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Rotted Zombies within Close range. Those Minions move into Melee with the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, each deals 2 physical damage. Combine the damage.
